summary: AFEtm Safety Check v3 regression PASSED on both backend and frontend. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed against public URL (no changes vs v2, spec-correct: HRR=hrs[1], AURC trapezoidal segments, tau@63.2%, no _id leak). Frontend E2E on web preview (390x844): profile setup -> home-cta-new -> mode-manual -> 4-step assessment -> /assessment/{id}. NEW: 'Curva de recuperación' section renders BEFORE 'Métricas de recuperación' with testID='result-recovery-chart' containing an SVG (2 <path> for line+area, 6 <circle> data points, 5 <line> = 3 grid + 2 refs, 1 <rect> bg). All expected labels present in SVG text nodes: axes 0s/60s/90s/120s/150s/180s, HR value labels 180/155/145/135/125/115, FCr 60 dashed ref line, FCP 152 dashed ref line, gradient area in zone color. The old numeric readings grid is relabelled 'Lecturas por checkpoint' (single 'Curva de recuperación' occurrence — no duplicate title). Zone banner shows Verde · Favorable / Normal / Continuar y mantener seguimiento (GREEN as requested). ZERO console errors, ZERO react-native-svg import warnings. Regression: guided-unsupported + guided-fallback-manual still present on web. Static code review of /app/frontend/src/hooks/useHeartRateMonitor.ts confirms backoff [1s,2s,3s,5s,8s,12s,20s,30s], autoReconnectRef gate on both onDisconnected and monitor-characteristic error, disconnect() cancels reconnectTimerRef + sets autoReconnectRef=false, hook exposes isReconnecting + reconnectAttempt. guided.tsx correctly uses capturedRef and hrPeakRef inside the recovery setInterval closure, with an 8s grace window (withinGrace = s>=t && s<=t+8) waiting for reconnection before falling back to hrPeakRef.current. testIDs guided-reconnect-banner (line 269) and guided-connection-pill (line 360) are wired to hr.isReconnecting / hr.reconnectAttempt / hr.status / hr.connectedDevice. BLE happy-path cannot be simulated on web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing cosmetic warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/assessment-flow/guided.tsx:619-620, /app/frontend/app/assessment/[id].tsx:330,339, /app/frontend/src/components/RecoveryChart.tsx (via colors/borders — none of the new SVG code uses shadow* props).

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* props to boxShadow across guided.tsx / [id].tsx to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
BLE auto-reconnect end-to-end verification requires a native dev-build with react-native-ble-plx (Expo Go / web preview cannot simulate BLE disconnects).
critical_code_review_comments: RecoveryChart.tsx: pure react-native-svg (Svg/Defs/G/Line/Path/Rect/Circle/Text + LinearGradient/Stop), no HTML tags, all styles via StyleSheet.create; smooth cubic-bezier line + gradient area in zoneColor; correctly guards ref lines with (padT<y<padT+h) so out-of-plot labels aren't rendered.
assessment/[id].tsx: RecoveryChart placed BEFORE metricsGrid inside testID='result-recovery-chart' wrapper; width clamps to min(width - 2*spacing.xl, 360) so it works on 375px viewports.

useHeartRateMonitor.ts: correct exponential backoff array; both disconnect paths (onDisconnected + monitor error) re-arm scheduleReconnect only if autoReconnectRef.current; reconnectTimerRef guarded against double-schedule; explicit disconnect() cancels timer and resets counters — spec-correct.

guided.tsx: capturedRef/hrPeakRef kept in sync via useEffects and used inside setInterval closure, avoiding stale-state bugs during long recovery; 8s grace window (s<=t+8) waits for reconnection before falling back to hrPeak; guided-reconnect-banner rendered only in recovery phase when hr.isReconnecting.
No react-native-svg import errors during full E2E: confirmed by 0 console errors and 2 <path>+6 <circle>+5 <line>+1 <rect> DOM elements rendered inside the chart's <svg>.
